name: Beelen (Germany)
description: Horizontal stripes of blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Beelen (a crowned black lion on blue and yellow lozenges).
history: Municipal flag of Beelen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Beelen arms — crowned lion over lozenges
